note: The tested bridge between the rulebook and the wall. Each claim names a command the instruction layers talk about and says whether a permission profile actually enforces it. harness-lint.ts asserts both halves, so a rule deleted from a layer or a deny removed from a profile fails a check instead of drifting silently.
